presentation.label: Testicular pain
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us about your symptoms and when they started.

questions.question: Is the pain severe?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the testicular pain is severe?

questions.question: Did the pain come on suddenly?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the testicular pain came on suddenly or rapidly?

questions.question: Is there any swelling or redness of the testicle or surrounding area?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate there is swelling or redness of the testicle or surrounding area?

questions.question: Have you noticed any new lumps on the testicle?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate there is a new lump on the testicle?

questions.question: Have you had any unprotected sexual contacts with new partners in the last three months?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate the patient has had unprotected sexual contacts with new partners recently?

testicular_torsion_urgent.message: Sudden or severe testicular pain can be a sign of testicular torsion, which is a medical emergency. Call the surgery and ask to speak to the duty doctor instead of sending an online form.
